symptom: Outdoor unit trips within minutes of start

actions.action: Replaced compressor contactor and checked phase voltages.
actions.detail: Contactor swapped as per the usual fix, but the unit tripped again within 20 minutes. Supply voltage was normal (228/229/227V).

recommendation: Unit installed 2023: the usual contactor fix did not hold.
notes: Newer-generation unit. Contactor looked healthy when removed.

symptom: Outdoor unit trips within minutes of start

actions.action: Replaced inverter PCB (A2P) and updated its firmware.
actions.detail: DC bus overvoltage trips traced to the inverter PCB; stable after replacement and firmware update.

root_cause: Inverter PCB (A2P, revision C) causes DC bus overvoltage trips on units installed 2023 onwards; supply voltage was normal.
fix: Replaced inverter PCB (A2P) and updated its firmware.
recommendation: On units installed from 2023, check the inverter PCB before replacing the contactor.
